options.label: Clause joins under R1 (Recommended)

This keeps your 'bare skeleton, filled after each session' cut.

options.description: State that shared.md's clauses join without a model too. That is the smallest edit, but it widens RFC-0024 R1, since unmodelled clauses become ground.

options.label: OP-21 only, amend D5
options.description: Keep OP-21 as the sole filler. RFC-0027 adds RFC-0024 D5 to what it amends and drops P3's 'D5 stands'. OP-01's lifetime questions go to Open items as shared: Lifetime until OP-21 runs.
